jobs.title: Associate Creative Director
jobs.description:
It's a great feeling to work for a company that does so much good for others around the world!

Academic Requirement:
Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Fine Arts, Communications, Graphic Design, or related field

Position Summary:

The Associate Creative Director is a dynamic, highly creative professional who helps shape and elevate the visual identity, brand presence, and communications of FirstDay Foundation and its affiliated nonprofit organizations.

Working within the Marketing, Branding, and Communications (MBC) team, the Associate Creative Director translates strategic goals into compelling visual experiences and communications across print, digital, web, social media, video, photography, and other platforms. This role offers an exciting opportunity to combine creative leadership, strategic thinking, and technical expertise in support of organizations making a meaningful difference in communities locally and around the world.

The ideal candidate is both a visionary creative thinker and a hands-on designer, and is someone who can develop a big-picture creative concept while also bringing the details to life. The Associate Creative Director thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, manages multiple priorities with confidence, and consistently delivers polished, accurate, and engaging work.

Required Qualifications:

Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in creative leadership, graphic design, branding, marketing, advertising, communications, or a related field.
Experience working in an advertising agency, creative agency, or other fast-paced communications environment.
Demonstrated experience developing client reports, proposals, presentations, strategic documents, or similar professional communications.
Strong portfolio showcasing creative direction, graphic design, branding, and visual storytelling.
Professional experience designing for both print and digital/web environments.
Demonstrated experience with video production, videography, and editing.
Experience with professional photography and photo editing.
Experience designing, developing, and maintaining websites.
Strong understanding of branding principles, visual identity systems, typography, layout, color, and design best practices.
Exceptional attention to detail, including strong proofreading and quality-control skills.
Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Strong project management, organization, and multitasking abilities.
Ability to collaborate effectively with a variety of teams, clients, vendors, and creative professionals.
Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and meet deadlines in a high-energy environment.
Genuine passion for nonprofit organizations and a commitment to advancing mission-driven work.

Technical Skills:

Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Experience with web design, HTML, content management systems, and digital publishing platforms.
Experience with WordPress and/or NetCommunity is a plus.
Familiarity with current digital marketing, social media, advertising, and communications platforms.
Knowledge of contemporary photography, video, editing, and production tools.

Work Experience:

The Associate Creative Director leads the organization’s creative vision and brand strategy, developing compelling visual and storytelling initiatives that advance FirstDay Foundation’s mission and engage donors, partners, volunteers, and the broader community. The Associate Creative Director must have a strong working knowledge of business branding and imaging theories and practices. Excellent graphic design and proofing skills are essential (minimum 5 years of professional design experience in print and web are required). This position works in a high-energy office that balances multiple creative projects taking place at one time that impact FirstDay Foundation operations worldwide.

Essential Functions and Measurable Deliverables:

Collaborate with MBC team members and organizational leadership to develop creative strategies that support FirstDay Foundation and its affiliate organizations.
Develop creative concepts and produce high-quality visual communications for marketing, public affairs, fundraising, events, and community outreach.
Lead the development of compelling print and digital materials, including brochures, reports, presentations, forms, advertisements, e-blasts, social media content, and other communications.
Create and maintain visual identities and brand standards, ensuring consistency across all communications and platforms.
Design, develop, and update websites and digital content as needed.
Produce engaging graphics and visual content for social media and digital campaigns.
Plan, capture, produce, and edit photography and video content to support organizational storytelling and communications.
Collaborate with internal teams, clients, vendors, photographers, printers, developers, and other creative partners to ensure successful project execution.
Coordinate production, printing, distribution, and assembly of marketing and communications materials.
Review and proof creative materials for accuracy, quality, consistency, and adherence to brand standards.
Contribute to strategic planning, client presentations, proposals, reports, and other communications documents.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards for creativity, accuracy, and timeliness.
Stay informed about emerging trends in design, branding, digital communications, advertising, social media, and nonprofit marketing.
Provide creative and communications support for special events and other organizational initiatives, as needed.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Other Responsibilities:

Provide communications support for events, as appropriate

jobs.title: Head of Integrated Marketing & Campaigns
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Carlyle is seeking a senior marketing leader to serve as Head of Integrated Marketing & Campaigns. This principal-level role will be responsible for orchestrating the firm's global campaign strategy - integrating brand, content, and channel activation to drive measurable impact, engagement, and performance across priority audiences.

This leader will translate firm strategy into cohesive, insight-led marketing programs that elevate Carlyle's brand, support capital formation, and strengthen stakeholder engagement globally. The role requires deep expertise across brand development, global advertising, media strategy and planning, and multi-channel execution - with a strong understanding of private markets and institutional investor audiences.

In-Office Requirement:
4 days per week
Responsibilites

Develop and lead global, multi-channel marketing campaigns aligned to firm priorities, fundraising objectives, and brand strategy.
Translate enterprise narratives into integrated programs spanning paid, owned, and earned channels.
Ensure consistent messaging and creative excellence across regions, business segments, and investment strategies.
Partner closely with Brand, Communications, and Investment Teams to align campaign ideation with firm positioning.
Integrate thought leadership, product marketing, and corporate storytelling into cohesive 360° activation strategies.
Maintain rigorous brand governance while enabling creative innovation.
Oversee global media planning and strategy across digital, social, programmatic, partnerships, and emerging platforms.
Establish performance frameworks and KPIs to measure engagement, brand lift, and business impact.
Optimize media allocation and channel mix to drive efficiency and ROI.
Develop campaigns tailored to a range of investor types from institutional to wealth channel (advisors, UHNW/HNW individuals, family offices), institutional investors, private wealth channels, consultants, and portfolio company stakeholders.
Demonstrate fluency in private markets offerings and concepts to ensure strategic alignment with fundraising cycles and product launches.
Lead end-to-end campaign execution from ideation through launch and post-campaign analysis.
Oversee agency partners and internal teams to ensure seamless delivery.
Implement structured planning, budget management, and reporting processes.

Requirements

Education & Certificates

Bachelor's degree, required
Concentration in Marketing, Business or a related field, preferred
Master's or MBA preferred

Professional Experience

12+ years of overall relevant experience, required
Marketing leadership experience, ideally within asset management, private markets, financial services, or a similarly complex B2B environment.
Proven experience concepting, developing and executing global integrated advertising campaigns.
Deep expertise in media strategy, planning, and performance optimization.
Managing significant media budgets across paid digital, programmatic, social, search, and premium media partnerships, with accountability for ROI, performance measurement, and optimization across channels.

Competencies & Attributes

Strong understanding of private markets and institutional investor audiences.
Experience leading cross-functional teams in a global matrixed organization.
Demonstrated ability to operate at both strategic and executional levels.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.

Benefits/Compensation

The compensation range for this role is specific to New York, NY and takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to the skill sets required/preferred; prior experience and training; licenses and/or certifications.

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $220,000 to $250,000.

In addition to the base salary, the hired professional will enjoy a comprehensive benefits package spanning retirement benefits, health insurance, life insurance and disability, paid time off, paid holidays, family planning benefits and various wellness programs. Additionally, the hired professional may also be eligible to participate in an annual discretionary incentive program, the award of which will be dependent on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Due to the high volume of candidates, please be advised that only candidates selected to interview will be contacted by Carlyle.

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Copy
jobs.description:
Description

You look beneath the surface to uncover creative, measurable, and more importantly, impactful solutions.

GSW is a full-service healthcare communications agency that goes beyond advertising to create personalized brand experiences that involve, inspire, educate and activate people through ongoing brand journeys.

At GSW, we foster a culture of collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. We believe in empowering our team members to bring their unique perspectives and ideas to the table. Our supportive environment encourages growth, innovation, and excellence, making GSW, not just a workplace, but a community where your creativity can thrive.

Role Overview:

You inspire and reach people with just a few words. As an Associate Creative Director, Copy
, you’ll be a strategic and creative leader, shaping the voice and messaging across campaigns. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including art, account and strategy—to deliver compelling, brand-aligned content that resonates with healthcare professionals and patients alike. This role combines creative vision, content strategy, and leadership to drive innovation and excellence in healthcare advertising.

Responsibilities:

Serve as the creative lead and “owner” of copy across assigned brands and campaigns.
Partner with art directors on brand and concept development, ensuring cohesive visual and verbal storytelling.
Lead the development of long-form and short-form content, maintaining brand tone, consistency, and regulatory compliance (MLR).
Collaborate with UX, Tech, and CX teams to align content with user experience and platform requirements.
Provide strategic input and creative leadership in client meetings and presentations.
Participate in market research and message testing to refine promotional content.
Mentor and manage copywriters, fostering a culture of creativity and collaboration.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in advertising, marketing, communications, English, journalism, or a related field.
8–10 years of experience in an agency setting, with at least 6 years in pharmaceutical copy leadership.
Exceptional copywriting, storytelling, and communication skills.
Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams and mentor creative talent.
Strong conceptual thinking and ability to connect abstract ideas into compelling narratives.
Deep understanding of social platforms (e.g., X/Twitter, Instagram, YouTube) and emerging cultural trends.
Experience navigating regulatory processes and medical/legal review (MLR).
Ability to quickly grasp complex medical and technical content and translate it into clear, engaging messaging.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $140,000 to $160,000 The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

At GSW, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

GSW is a full-service healthcare communications agency that goes beyond advertising to create personalized brand experiences that involve, inspire, educate and activate people through ongoing brand journeys. As one of the world’s ten most-awarded healthcare advertising agencies, GSW is hell-bent not to replace the same old with the same old. This is achieved through a provocative premise — if other brands communicated the way healthcare brands do, how many customers would they have? GSW turns against this premise through discovery of beneath-the-surface customer insights that we impact with stories, simplicity and authenticity.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Art
jobs.description:
At Big Spaceship, we're explorers, not settlers. We partner with ambitious brands ready to venture into new territory, push creative boundaries, and lead rather than follow.

We're a full-service creative shop built for brands that want to break new ground. Our diverse team of entrepreneurial spirits, creative minds, and makers brings bold ideas to life for some of the world's most innovative and culturally connected brands. If you thrive on exploration, creative risk-taking, and charting new paths, you belong here.

We are seeking an Associate Creative Director, Art to lead and elevate creative for a portfolio of high-profile clients across luxury, travel, and financial services. This role will play a critical leadership position on major integrated campaigns, with significant upfront concept development, partnership work, activations, social, and production.

The ideal candidate brings a refined design sensibility, strong conceptual thinking, and the ability to turn strategic opportunities into distinctive, culturally relevant creative. You should be equally comfortable developing big ideas and getting hands-on in the work, from early concepts through production and launch. Experience working with luxury, travel, financial services, sports, or other highly visible consumer brands is valuable.

Our clients are collaborative and engaged, but projects can involve multiple layers of approval and, in some cases, conservative brand environments or significant business constraints. We're looking for someone who knows how to navigate those realities without letting them compromise the ambition of the work — someone who keeps pushing, finds smart creative solutions, and can advocate for great ideas with confidence and diplomacy.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role. You should have strong conceptual chops, be comfortable on set, understand the importance of social and digital-first thinking, and bring a low-ego approach to collaboration. You'll work closely with your creative partner and cross-functional teams to develop work that is strategically sound, beautifully crafted, and built to make an impact.

Roles + Responsibilities:

Lead concept development and art direction for major integrated, 360 campaigns
Develop bold, strategically grounded ideas across campaigns, partnerships, activations, social, digital, and experiential
Bring a refined visual point of view and high level of craft to every stage of the creative process
Be hands-on in the work, from initial concepts and visual exploration through production and execution
Present creative work to clients with confidence, clearly articulating the rationale, vision, and opportunity behind the work
Partner closely with your creative counterpart, strategy, account, production, and cross-functional teams to ensure cohesive creative execution
Help develop creative for high-profile brand partnerships, including sports and cultural activations
Lead creative through production, including participating in and providing direction on shoots
Create work that translates effectively across campaign touchpoints, with a strong understanding of social and digital channels
Navigate complex client environments, approval processes, brand guidelines, and business constraints while continuing to push the work forward
Integrate AI tools into the creative process to enhance ideation, design, and production workflows
Operate autonomously, managing timelines and deliverables while maintaining creative quality
Identify and solve complex creative challenges with thoughtful, design-forward solutions
Foster a collaborative, low-ego creative environment and contribute to the growth of the broader creative team

Requirements

7+ years of experience in advertising, digital, or full-service agencies, with a strong art direction background
Experience developing integrated campaigns for luxury, travel, financial services, sports, or other premium consumer brands
Strong conceptual thinker with a portfolio demonstrating distinctive ideas, visual excellence, and integrated campaign work
Demonstrated ability to take an idea from concept through production and execution
Hands-on art direction experience, including experience on set
Experience with social and digital creative, with an understanding of how ideas translate across platforms
Experience with partnerships, activations, experiential, or culturally relevant brand work is a plus
Comfortable working within complex brand, business, or regulatory constraints while continuing to push creative ambition
Confident and polished client presentation skills, with the ability to navigate multiple stakeholders and levels of approval
Strong strategic instincts and ability to translate briefs into compelling visual narratives
Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely across disciplines
Low-ego, collaborative approach with a willingness to get into the work
Proficiency and comfort using AI as part of the creative toolkit

Benefits

The salary band for this role is $135,000 - $170,000. Where a prospective new hire's base salary will fall within this band depends on several factors including their qualifications and experience, the skill level required in the role, market rates, and the salaries of existing crew members at Big Spaceship within the same role to maintain equity.

Product Design Director (Individual Contributor), Customer Acquisitions and Management

We’re currently seeking a Product Design Director Individual Contributor (IC) to join our Customer Acquisitions and Management team, part of the Experience Design organization. In this role, you’ll lead design execution and elevate craft excellence across high-impact programs. The role involves navigating organizational complexity across multiple lines of business and managing matrixed stakeholders to deliver best-in-class customer experiences to core revenue-driving products.

The Experience Design team at Capital One is at the forefront of enriching our customers’ digital and physical experiences and we are passionate about creating memorable, meaningful product experiences that build the Capital One brand with humanity and drive business advantage and innovation. We champion a thriving environment of collaboration, authenticity and healthy critique, in which we honor diversity of thought, create a culture of belonging, and elevate one another. If you’re a creative innovator who embraces an environment where you can experiment, learn, and change banking for good, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Expectations

As a Product Design Director IC on the Customer Acquisitions and Management, you’ll leverage your exceptional design skills to lead high-impact programs within revenue-generating products, navigating organizational complexity and delivering best-in-class customer experiences. You’ll define and drive design strategy that informs the higher-level vision of the organization and align to business objectives. You’ll collaborate deeply with our research teams and Product and Tech leadership and apply your expertise to elevating the quality and maturity of the design practice at Capital One.

Here are some of the expected competencies for this role:

Product Design Expertise:
Leverage established expertise and leadership in product design to elevate the quality and maturity of the design practice at Capital One. Leveraging a variety of skills across interaction, visual and service design; in collaboration with cross-functional partners, help to oversee and optimize the use of appropriate tools, platforms, frameworks and design systems and develop artifacts that may include vision stories, journey maps, blueprints, high-fidelity designs and prototypes

Mentorship:
Provide guidance, direction and mentorship to other design roles, such as product design, content design, research, operations, service design and motion design, and lead complex projects, directing the work of junior designers

Strategic Influence:
Shape product direction and outcomes by leveraging deep product design expertise, user insights, and an understanding of the business. You'll drive alignment with cross functional senior leaders, ensuring user needs are central to our overall strategy and enabling bold, innovative solutions to complex problems.

Human-Centered:
Champion voices of both customers and partners, modeling the mindset that business and customer outcomes are not distinct but complementary, ultimately resulting in experiences that exceed baseline customer needs and expectations

Business-Focused
: Demonstrate expert knowledge of products, processes, our customers, competitors and industry market trends, applying relevant insights to shape how Design should engage and solve business challenges

Problem-Solving:
Brings innovative solutions, thoroughly explores the solution space, clearly articulates constraints and balances facts, priorities, technical limitations and data to inform decision making

Collaboration:
Connect the dots across teams, portfolios, platforms and LOBs, bringing together partners and processes in ways that drive more coherent experiences, accelerate delivery and elevate the value of design

Communication:
Present work across levels and job functions, modeling a strategic human-centered approach that integrates design frameworks, data and research insights to make the complex accessible, influence senior stakeholders and achieve impactful results

The ideal candidate has a strong portfolio demonstrating your leadership, process, results and impact.

Basic Qualifications:

At least 8 years of experience in a product design role

Preferred Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in a product design role
Has experience in a design toolkit that spans product design, service design, and content design
Experience leading high-impact, highly complex projects from strategy through delivery to market
Experience partnering with product managers, engineers, marketing, and analytics leaders across multiple business lines to shape strategy, OKRs, roadmaps, and operating models
Experience working within an design system
Proficiency with web and mobile technologies and platforms, navigating technology considerations and constraints to drive sound product and experience decisions
Expertise with design and prototyping tools such as Figma
Proficiency in business case development, grounding product and user experience decisions to business value
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
Exceptional interpersonal skills and relationship building across complex organizations

jobs.title: Principal AI Creative Director, POD
jobs.description:
Description

Advertising is being remade. The brands that win the next decade will be the ones that figure out how to deliver creative that is personal, performant, and produced at a scale no human team can match alone. Generative AI is the unlock. But generation alone is not the advantage. The advantage belongs to the system that connects creation to delivery to learning, and gets better with every impression.

Amazon Ads is building that system. We are investing in the models, the infrastructure, and the product intelligence to make personalized, brand-aligned creative a default capability for every advertiser, not a luxury reserved for the largest budgets. The work is early, the stakes are high, and the opportunity to define how this category develops is real. We are building that system. We need a Principal AI Creative Director to define what great looks like inside it and to make that definition teachable, scalable, and machine-readable.

Key job responsibilities

As Principal AI Creative Director for Personalization Optimization and Design (POD), you are the human judgment layer at the center of Amazon's AI creative system. Generative AI has commoditized asset creation. The durable differentiator is now creative direction: the taste, the standards, the brand intelligence, and the systematic thinking that ensures our system produces creative that builds brands, not just optimizes clicks.

This is not a role about using AI tools, though you must be among the most fluent practitioners working today. It is about understanding what makes a great commercial, a great piece of content, a great brand moment, and then decomposing that understanding into primitives: the story arc, the color logic, the compositional tension, the emotional beat, the brand signal. Those primitives are what our systems learn from, replicate, and eventually govern at scale.

You will operate as a principal-level individual contributor with org-wide influence, partnering directly with design, engineering, science, and product leadership across every surface (POD) owns.

A day in the life

Creative Direction And Quality Standards

Define and own the creative quality bar for AI-generated assets across POD's full portfolio, including images, video, copy, and multi-format compositions. Establish brand intelligence frameworks that ensure AI outputs are aesthetically coherent, emotionally resonant, and brand-safe at scale. Act as the senior creative editor for AI-generated content, distinguishing exceptional work from "good enough" outputs and articulating the difference in decomposable, teachable terms.

Decomposing Creative into Primitives.

Lead the Systemization of Taste: Break down what makes great creative into its constituent elements: narrative structure, color theory, compositional hierarchy, emotional arc, pacing, and brand signal. Translate these primitives into structured frameworks, including prompt libraries, creative briefs, quality rubrics, and annotation schemas, that inform model training, DCO reward signals, and creative tooling. Define the primitives that power aesthetic moderation: the signals and thresholds that allow our systems to evaluate, filter, and rank AI-generated content without requiring human review of every asset. Partner with applied science and engineering to operationalize these as machine-readable inputs.

Hands-On Production And Prototyping

Produce high-quality creative content independently across modalities, including image, video, and copy, using the leading AI creation tools. Bring that same hands-on fluency to prototyping: build working creative prototypes that demonstrate new customer experiences, surface trade-offs, and create decision points for design, product, and engineering leadership. This role operates in a demo-driven culture where prototypes move decisions. You are expected to contribute directly to that culture, not just direct others within it. Maintain current, deep fluency across tools including text-to-image (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Stable Diffusion), text-to-video (Sora, Runway, Kling), and LLM-powered copy and agentic workflows.

Defining New Creative Experiences

Partner with design, product, and engineering to define what new AI-powered creative experiences should look and feel like for advertisers.

Translate Creative Vision into CX direction: How should a brand interact with a generative creative system? What does a great AI-assisted creative workflow feel like? Advise on the experience design for advertiser-facing tools, including Creative Studio, Video Generator, and the creative agent, ensuring AI capabilities are surfaced in ways that are legible, trustworthy, and creatively empowering.

Aesthetic Moderation And Governance

Build and own the aesthetic moderation framework for POD: the multi-dimensional quality scorecard that defines what "premium creative" means in measurable, auditable terms across visual quality, brand alignment, emotional resonance, and format appropriateness. Establish governance processes, including quality thresholds, brand safety standards, and editorial review workflows, that scale without requiring human review of every asset. Partner with advertiser-facing teams to translate brand requirements into creative direction that AI systems can operationalize and enforce.

Cross-Functional Creative Leadership

Serve as the creative authority in cross-functional conversations with engineering, science, product, and design leadership, earning influence through demonstrated quality and creative vision. Partner with the Design Technology team to ensure prototypes reflect a high creative bar before graduating into engineering roadmaps. Collaborate with PAO (Creative Personalization and Optimization) to ensure personalized creative variants maintain quality and brand coherence at impression level.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of creative direction experience, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across visual design, brand identity, advertising, or digital creative
2+ years of demonstrated, hands-on work in AI content creation, including major campaigns, brand work, or personal projects that showcase advanced fluency with generative AI tools across image, video, and copy
Ability to produce finished creative content independently across modalities using AI tools, not just direct others to do so
Deep understanding of what makes great creative, including narrative structure, color theory, compositional hierarchy, emotional arc, pacing, and brand signal, and the ability to articulate these elements in precise, teachable, decomposable terms
Experience working at the intersection of creative and technology, collaborating with engineering, product, or data science teams to build creative systems
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority in large, cross-functional organizations

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in advertising, e-commerce, or performance marketing contexts, with an understanding of how creative connects to business metrics, conversion, and brand equity
Experience building creative quality frameworks, brand standards, or design systems that scale across large organizations or product portfolios
Track record of translating creative intuition into structured, systematic frameworks, including prompt libraries, quality rubrics, annotation schemas, or training data curation
Familiarity with aesthetic moderation, content quality scoring, or automated creative evaluation
Familiarity with Dynamic Creative Optimization (DCO), personalization systems, or data-driven creative
Experience contributing to or advising on AI model development from a creative direction perspective, including feedback on outputs, training data curation, or quality reward signal definition
Proficiency with design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) to refine, annotate, and communicate creative direction alongside AI-generated outputs

new_jobs.title: Principal AI Creative Director, POD
new_jobs.description:
Description

Advertising is being remade. The brands that win the next decade will be the ones that figure out how to deliver creative that is personal, performant, and produced at a scale no human team can match alone. Generative AI is the unlock. But generation alone is not the advantage. The advantage belongs to the system that connects creation to delivery to learning, and gets better with every impression.

Amazon Ads is building that system. We are investing in the models, the infrastructure, and the product intelligence to make personalized, brand-aligned creative a default capability for every advertiser, not a luxury reserved for the largest budgets. The work is early, the stakes are high, and the opportunity to define how this category develops is real. We are building that system. We need a Principal AI Creative Director to define what great looks like inside it and to make that definition teachable, scalable, and machine-readable.

Key job responsibilities

As Principal AI Creative Director for Personalization Optimization and Design (POD), you are the human judgment layer at the center of Amazon's AI creative system. Generative AI has commoditized asset creation. The durable differentiator is now creative direction: the taste, the standards, the brand intelligence, and the systematic thinking that ensures our system produces creative that builds brands, not just optimizes clicks.

This is not a role about using AI tools, though you must be among the most fluent practitioners working today. It is about understanding what makes a great commercial, a great piece of content, a great brand moment, and then decomposing that understanding into primitives: the story arc, the color logic, the compositional tension, the emotional beat, the brand signal. Those primitives are what our systems learn from, replicate, and eventually govern at scale.

You will operate as a principal-level individual contributor with org-wide influence, partnering directly with design, engineering, science, and product leadership across every surface (POD) owns.

A day in the life

Creative Direction And Quality Standards

Define and own the creative quality bar for AI-generated assets across POD's full portfolio, including images, video, copy, and multi-format compositions. Establish brand intelligence frameworks that ensure AI outputs are aesthetically coherent, emotionally resonant, and brand-safe at scale. Act as the senior creative editor for AI-generated content, distinguishing exceptional work from "good enough" outputs and articulating the difference in decomposable, teachable terms.

Decomposing Creative into Primitives.

Lead the Systemization of Taste: Break down what makes great creative into its constituent elements: narrative structure, color theory, compositional hierarchy, emotional arc, pacing, and brand signal. Translate these primitives into structured frameworks, including prompt libraries, creative briefs, quality rubrics, and annotation schemas, that inform model training, DCO reward signals, and creative tooling. Define the primitives that power aesthetic moderation: the signals and thresholds that allow our systems to evaluate, filter, and rank AI-generated content without requiring human review of every asset. Partner with applied science and engineering to operationalize these as machine-readable inputs.

Hands-On Production And Prototyping

Produce high-quality creative content independently across modalities, including image, video, and copy, using the leading AI creation tools. Bring that same hands-on fluency to prototyping: build working creative prototypes that demonstrate new customer experiences, surface trade-offs, and create decision points for design, product, and engineering leadership. This role operates in a demo-driven culture where prototypes move decisions. You are expected to contribute directly to that culture, not just direct others within it. Maintain current, deep fluency across tools including text-to-image (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Stable Diffusion), text-to-video (Sora, Runway, Kling), and LLM-powered copy and agentic workflows.

Defining New Creative Experiences

Partner with design, product, and engineering to define what new AI-powered creative experiences should look and feel like for advertisers.

Translate Creative Vision into CX direction: How should a brand interact with a generative creative system? What does a great AI-assisted creative workflow feel like? Advise on the experience design for advertiser-facing tools, including Creative Studio, Video Generator, and the creative agent, ensuring AI capabilities are surfaced in ways that are legible, trustworthy, and creatively empowering.

Aesthetic Moderation And Governance

Build and own the aesthetic moderation framework for POD: the multi-dimensional quality scorecard that defines what "premium creative" means in measurable, auditable terms across visual quality, brand alignment, emotional resonance, and format appropriateness. Establish governance processes, including quality thresholds, brand safety standards, and editorial review workflows, that scale without requiring human review of every asset. Partner with advertiser-facing teams to translate brand requirements into creative direction that AI systems can operationalize and enforce.

Cross-Functional Creative Leadership

Serve as the creative authority in cross-functional conversations with engineering, science, product, and design leadership, earning influence through demonstrated quality and creative vision. Partner with the Design Technology team to ensure prototypes reflect a high creative bar before graduating into engineering roadmaps. Collaborate with PAO (Creative Personalization and Optimization) to ensure personalized creative variants maintain quality and brand coherence at impression level.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of creative direction experience, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across visual design, brand identity, advertising, or digital creative
2+ years of demonstrated, hands-on work in AI content creation, including major campaigns, brand work, or personal projects that showcase advanced fluency with generative AI tools across image, video, and copy
Ability to produce finished creative content independently across modalities using AI tools, not just direct others to do so
Deep understanding of what makes great creative, including narrative structure, color theory, compositional hierarchy, emotional arc, pacing, and brand signal, and the ability to articulate these elements in precise, teachable, decomposable terms
Experience working at the intersection of creative and technology, collaborating with engineering, product, or data science teams to build creative systems
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority in large, cross-functional organizations

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in advertising, e-commerce, or performance marketing contexts, with an understanding of how creative connects to business metrics, conversion, and brand equity
Experience building creative quality frameworks, brand standards, or design systems that scale across large organizations or product portfolios
Track record of translating creative intuition into structured, systematic frameworks, including prompt libraries, quality rubrics, annotation schemas, or training data curation
